messages:
thomas: Starting a focused follow-up thread for the streaming partials + timeout recurrence observed 2026-03-24 02:10 UTC. Customers saw truncated streams and client reconnect storms.
eli: Summary: upstream object store latency spikes + aggressive client reconnect logic amplified the outage. I linked the postmortem draft earlier.
ops-bot: Incident action: rolled back recent streaming gateway kernel at 02:45 UTC. Errors dropped to baseline after rollback.
maria: We need concrete remediation owners with firm short-term timelines and a plan for treating this as a recurring incident pattern.
sam: I'll own the client SDK fix: implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap retries, and stop retrying on 4xx/401. Plan: PR with tests by EOD, code review next day, release in the next patch cycle.
thomas: I'll take server-side responsibilities: audit keepalive/timeouts and KV-cache eviction windows. Proposed canary: 5% traffic with tightened keepalive (10s -> 6s) to ensure we don't mask latent issues. Canary window: tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
maria: Ops: add circuit breaker metrics and an alert for streaming partials + reconnect surge. Ops, please wire paging to oncall.
ops-bot: Alert created: streaming.partial_rate > 0.3% over 5m -> page oncall. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/streaming-partials
eli: Add a synthetic test: 500 concurrent streams with injected S3 tail-latency of +100ms to reproduce conditions. I'll add that as a nightly CI job. ETA 72h.
sam: Client snippet for reviewers:
```js
let attempt = 0;
function reconnectDelay() {
  attempt++;
  const base = 500;
  const jitter = Math.random() * base;
  return Math.min(base * 2 ** attempt + jitter, 8000);
}
// Reset attempt on successful open or after max attempts
```
maria: Action tracker (owners and dates):
- Client SDK backoff + stop-on-4xx (owner: sam, due: 2026-04-05)
- Keepalive/config audit + canary (owner: thomas, canary start: 2026-03-26 09:00 UTC)
- Synthetic CI test (owner: eli, due: 2026-03-29)
- Dashboard + alert verification (owner: maria, verify by 2026-03-25)
- Postmortem follow-up doc with regression tests and SLA impact calc (owner: eli, due: 2026-03-28)
eli: Note: this is the third partial-response cluster in ~60 days (2026-01-15, 2026-02-23, 2026-03-24). Treat as a recurring class; consider longer-term fixes for streaming gateway resiliency.
thomas: I'll open a GH issue for architectural work: streaming gateway resiliency (connection pooling, graceful degrade, KV soft-failures). Prioritize in infra roadmap.
sam: I'll link the PR and rollout notes here when ready. Release criteria: no replay storms and reconnects <= 0.1% sustained for 15m.
maria: Ops, ensure alert runbooks include rollback criteria and customer comms template.
ops-bot: Runbook created: streaming-partial-responses.md. Rollback criteria: error rate < 0.05% and reconnect rate < 0.1% for 15m.
eli: Owners: include deployment playbook steps in each PR and handoff notes to oncall.
thomas: Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow to review canary results and close actions. Invite: @maria @eli @sam.
maria: Will verify dashboards and compile follow-up doc after sync. Small updates in this thread OK, major changes prefer the postmortem doc.
sam: Quick clarification: client will NOT retry on 401/403; on 429 we'll apply backoff but include exponential cap.
eli: Also adding a monitoring tag to traces for streaming reconnects to measure client-versus-server contribution.
thomas: I'll post canary results here + update timestamps. Keeping this thread for action updates only.
